observable: Total volume in fL by Coulter sizing against bath osmolarity in mOsm/L. The inferred aqueous volume is total volume less the study's estimate of osmotically inactive volume.

ghosts.locator: Table II, series prepared by hemolysis at 126 mOsm/L
ghosts.preparation: Fresh human erythrocyte ghosts resealed at 37 °C, sized in a thermostated probe and vial at 37 °C. The study gives 12–15 determinations per mean.

intact.preparation: Intact human erythrocytes. The temperature of the intact-cell sizing is unspecified.

mapping: Each preparation supplies its own trapped amount from the first listed measurement. Use equal hydrostatic pressures and zero stiffness. Reported SDs refer to volume determinations. The input osmolarities and inactive-volume estimates also carry uncertainty.
